sources.note: NextChat v2.16.1 source revision. The target is NextChat itself, not ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini's application.
Default submitKey is SubmitKey.Enter; alternatives are individually configurable modifier chords.
Unmodified Enter submission with composition guards, stop, rename and text edit controls. Retry removes source rows and is not mapped to ordinary Send.
User rows reverse direction; both roles have rounded bordered message items with a distinct user surface.
Dark-theme projection and source responsive sizing. Selecting this palette does not assert that dark is the source application's default theme.
Conversation-list selection is implemented through selectSession; Loom uses its own stable conversation IDs.

gaps: This maps selected NextChat 2.16.1 source behavior; it does not establish fidelity to any version of ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini's native app.

No pixel comparison was run against a deployed NextChat instance. Fonts, icons, avatars, per-role bubble surfaces, exact borders, responsive message percentages, draggable/narrow sidebar and mobile navigation remain partial.

The 900-pixel content width is a Loom desktop projection of a 1200-pixel source window minus the 300-pixel sidebar, not the source's responsive layout. The muted token reuses source text color; border alpha is rounded to an 8-bit hex color.
Alternative Alt/Ctrl/Shift/Meta Enter settings, Safari keyCode 229 handling, prompt hints, colon commands and ArrowUp last-input recall are not reproduced by the selected composer preset.

Loom edits preserve prior versions; the source mutates stored message content in place. The source Retry deletes the original user/assistant rows before resending and is intentionally not advertised as implemented.

Masks, source context compression, artifacts, images, MCP/plugins, voice/realtime chat, provider-specific request compilation and source persistence require additional adapters; model and context choices remain independent.
Source Stop can stop all pending responses; the current Loom control cancels its selected request/subscription rather than reproducing the global pool behavior.
conversation-review and Inspect Loom knowledge are explicit Loom additions, not claims about NextChat's native workflow.
